title: INTRO TO EDUCATIONAL PLANNING
description: Introduces students to the effective teaching cycle and explores research on how students learn. Explores learning theory and the relationship between teaching and learning as a foundation for educational planning. Investigates standards, creates learning objectives, considers outcomes, and plans lessons that meet diverse student needs while incorporating learning research and curriculum resources.
registration_restrictions: Enrollment is limited to students with a major in Secondary Education (A041).
recommendations: Analytical, critical thinking, and evaluation skills
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
meeting_html: MW 4pm-5:20pm in FURM 303 - Joyce Collin Furman Hall 303 (9/23 to 12/4)
